hypothesis_additions.claim: Coinbase remains a strategically important USDC distributor whose economics are linked to Coinbase-held USDC and broader ecosystem growth.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: The precise Coinbase platform-share percentage and Q3 settlement amounts under the agreement are not disclosed in these captured materials. Circle's 19.5% metric is Circle's own platform share, not Coinbase's.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Coinbase has material XRP collateral exposure in its Q3 2026 recognized institutional lending or derivatives book.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: The recognized derivatives table names BTC and ETH only. Recognized lending 'other crypto assets' totals USD9.903M without asset breakdown; the unrecognized USD2.804112B customer crypto collateral is not token-itemized. No XRP-specific amount is disclosed.

hypothesis_additions.claim: Circle Mint net issuance/redemption flows can serve as a leading indicator of XRP demand through stablecoin settlement or bridge activity.
hypothesis_additions.counterevidence: The metric is Circle Mint customer fiat conversion activity, not all USDC supply/secondary-market activity. No XRPL route-level USDC/RLUSD-to-XRP conversion or XRP bridge flow is measured. Circle Arc and other rails can settle stablecoins without native XRP.
